purpose: Ingest leading-zero discoveries spanning industrial supply-chain modeling, multimodal ML data, shock-tube combustion, current endpoint-management security, multi-omics data and Polarstern environmental sensing while preserving exact five-character target strings.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, standard, method, software resource, environmental record or information item receives a Worldshepherd use when it materially improves any capability, or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Dataset/publication mirrors, NVD/vendor release-note aliases and repository copies for the same underlying item are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: DOI components, advisory IDs, funding IDs, release URL components and event IDs may be useful to Worldshepherd but carry zero automatic Glob evidence; leading zeros are preserved exactly and are never silently normalized.

sources.title: A reliable framework for supply chain management using cluster based blockchain for intelligent industrial automation
sources.note: Use as an architecture/benchmark reference for combining supply-chain records, cluster structure and software/ML metrics. 03401 is a DOI component.

sources.title: A multimodal dental dataset facilitating machine learning research and clinic services
sources.note: Use multimodal imaging/data packaging as a benchmark for dataset documentation, modality alignment and ML-ready data provenance. 04130 is a DOI component.

sources.title: Dataset for Laser Absorption Shock Tube Study of C1 to C4 n-Alkyl Formate Pyrolysis
sources.note: Use experimental shock-tube/laser-absorption data as a model-to-measurement validation precedent and reproducible dataset pattern. 01043 is a DOI component.

sources.title: INTEL-SA-01434 — Intel Endpoint Management Assistant privilege escalation
sources.authority: Intel Product Security Incident Response Team
sources.note: Use adjacent-access/improper-input-validation and explicit fixed-version boundaries as endpoint-management hardening inputs. Intel recommends EMA 1.14.5 or later. 01434 is the advisory ID.

sources.title: Multi-omics profiling of cachexia-targeted tissues reveals a spatio-temporally coordinated response to cancer
sources.note: Use linked publication/data provenance and multimodal longitudinal analysis as a methodological reference. 01434 is the DOI component.

sources.title: Radiosonde PS14/04413 during POLARSTERN cruise ANT-VII/1
sources.note: Use the 2,979-point vertical profile and explicit campaign/event/device provenance as an environmental sensor-ingestion and replay benchmark. 04413 is the event identifier.

sources.title: Radiosonde PS16/04341 during POLARSTERN cruise ANT-VIII/1
sources.note: Use the 2,327-point atmospheric profile and source/campaign/device metadata as a second independent environmental replay/control dataset. 04341 is the event identifier.

sources.title: Electronic News Dataset for Native Advertisement Detection
sources.note: Use collection/annotation methodology and implicit-characteristic labeling as a benchmark for deceptive-content/native-ad classification data. 04341 is a DOI component.

sources.title: Modelled responses of the Kalahari Desert to 21st century climate and land use change
sources.note: Use open Python ViSTA model availability and climate/land-use scenario coupling as a reproducible environmental-modeling precedent. 04341 is a DOI component.

information_updates.finding: Leading-zero states generate meaningful exact-string collisions across DOI, advisory, event and funding namespaces. Preserving the five-character string is therefore necessary both for deterministic permutation provenance and for unbiased collision measurement.
information_updates.claims_boundary: This is a data/provenance requirement, not evidence for physical significance of leading-zero states.

information_updates.finding: PANGAEA Polarstern radiosonde records provide compact sensor-replay exemplars with explicit platform, campaign, event, timestamp, location, altitude range, device and parameter units. Worldshepherd can reuse this record structure for multi-sensor environmental campaigns.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Schema/replay methodology only; the historical atmospheric measurements do not validate Glob numerics.

information_updates.finding: The dental and cachexia datasets reinforce a common governance pattern: preserve modality identity, acquisition provenance, linked publication, subject/sample relationships and access constraints so downstream ML results remain auditable.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Cross-domain schema synthesis only; biomedical conclusions are not generalized.

next_actions: Continue exact-string leading-zero multiplicity scans and quantify whether leading-zero targets have different namespace profiles from other states.
